nearest_work.role: matched acceptance baseline and optional within-stage statistical acceptor

adoption_decision.residual: ordered non-compensatory STATIC→REPLAY→FRESH→PROTECTED evidence with independent fresh-transfer and protected custody, immutable negative history, harmful/uncertain evidence veto, and host-only promotion recommendation

primary_hypothesis.text: Relative to P5 V1 and matched acceptance baselines, non-compensatory staged acceptance reduces harmful fresh transfer and false protected acceptance while preserving protected fresh-task improvement within a predeclared non-inferiority margin.
primary_hypothesis.decision_rule: V2 must improve at least one safety endpoint by >=0.02 absolute, worsen neither safety endpoint, and keep protected fresh-task improvement within -0.02 absolute of V1/strongest matched comparator.

secondary_hypotheses.text: Replay success cannot compensate fresh-transfer harm; staged non-compensation lowers replay-overfit acceptance.
Protected CANNOT_CHECK blocks promotion rather than being averaged with earlier positive scores.
Append-only negative history reduces repeated harmful/null candidate admission without unacceptable cost inflation.

STATIC.pass: all frozen static and invariant checks pass
STATIC.fail: any frozen static or invariant check fails
STATIC.cannot_check: required static checker or bound artifact is unavailable

REPLAY.purpose: motivation/replay verification on previously exposed development evidence
REPLAY.pass: replay evidence meets frozen non-harm and acceptance rule
REPLAY.fail: replay regression, harmful behavior, or acceptance-test failure
REPLAY.cannot_check: required replay evidence is unavailable or invalid

FRESH.purpose: independent fresh-transfer evaluation unavailable as development feedback
FRESH.pass: fresh evidence meets frozen improvement/non-harm rule
FRESH.fail: fresh harmful transfer, regression beyond frozen margin, or acceptance-test failure
FRESH.cannot_check: fresh split/evidence is unavailable, contaminated, or invalid

PROTECTED.purpose: independently custodied evaluator/holdout and authority-integrity assessment
PROTECTED.pass: protected evaluator returns admissible PASS on exact bound candidate/epoch
PROTECTED.fail: protected evaluator returns FAIL or detects compromise
PROTECTED.cannot_check: protected evaluator cannot establish admissible evidence

global_decision_rules.harmful_precedence: any known harmful stage forces REJECT even if an earlier stage is missing
global_decision_rules.cannot_check_precedence: absent known harm/FAIL, any known CANNOT_CHECK forces CANNOT_CHECK
global_decision_rules.missing_stage: otherwise any missing required stage leaves IN_PROGRESS
global_decision_rules.complete_pass: only PASS at all four stages may yield RECOMMEND_HOST_PROMOTION
global_decision_rules.negative_history: append-only; failed, harmful, null and CANNOT_CHECK revisions remain retained

acceptance_statistics.pace_role: When a stage repeatedly compares noisy paired scores under adaptive candidate proposals, use a prospectively frozen anytime-valid/e-process acceptor or a justified stronger equivalent; this statistical mechanism is prior art and not P5 novelty.

statistics.unit: hidden-cause candidate-development episode with matched V1/V2/acceptance-baseline comparison
statistics.intervals: Wilson 95% intervals for rates; paired percentile bootstrap (10000 resamples) for matched protected-improvement differences; catastrophic family/tail harms reported separately
statistics.multiplicity: single primary V2 safety+noninferiority decision; Holm correction for inferential secondary families
statistics.tails: never average away catastrophic fresh/protected regressions

resource_policy: All V1/V2/baseline arms receive matched maximum candidate, LLM, tool, time and evaluator budgets. Early-stopping acceptance may consume less actual evaluation; actual cost is reported and may not be reallocated post hoc to a single arm.
required_artifacts: exact acceptance-test configuration and error budget
